A_SUBJECT_IDENTITY_TO_OBJECT_REF.SUBJECT_AUTHORITY_OBJECT_REFERENCE_RULE: A lease targeting a Subject uses a typed object reference with object_kind/type=Subject and object_id equal to the canonical Subject internal ID. Possessing a bare Subject ID is not itself authority and is not sufficient to authorize any operation. Model-facing semantic references must be resolved to the typed object reference at the trusted boundary; raw internal IDs are not normal model input.
A_SUBJECT_IDENTITY_TO_OBJECT_REF.source: A1 subject_identity_rule SUBJECT_ID_IS_AUTHORITY=no + A2 id_model (semantic_public_reference explicit_contract_only; internal_durable_object_id model_facing=no)

B_PRINCIPAL_TO_EXECUTOR.executor_identity_flag_source: A2 exact frozen truth (design_truths.EXECUTOR_IDENTITY_IS_PRINCIPAL=no); not context-dependent
B_PRINCIPAL_TO_EXECUTOR.trusted_mapping_boundary: Only the trusted runtime/adapter injection boundary may bind a channel to a typed Principal, with channel/provenance/freshness evidence. executor_kind and executor_execution_ref remain adapter-private; an executor change creates a new Execution under the same Subject.
B_PRINCIPAL_TO_EXECUTOR.authority_change_rule: Any principal/authority change requires explicit trusted mapping plus authority evaluation plus a valid capability lease; never silent derivation from executor identity.
B_PRINCIPAL_TO_EXECUTOR.source: A1 D-M3A1-03 / Execution record (CHANGE_EXECUTOR != CHANGE_SUBJECT) + A2 principal_model/principal_binding_rule (EXECUTOR_IDENTITY_IS_PRINCIPAL=no)

C_EXECUTION_TO_AUTHORITY_TARGET.universal_target_rule: No single universal authority target is chosen. Authority targets are operation-specific and typed; no heuristic target inference and no heuristic subject selection.

typed_target_map.Subject: typed authority target for Subject mechanical/lifecycle/lineage operations (the Subject aggregate)
typed_target_map.Execution: typed authority target for execution attempt/status/completion-related operations
typed_target_map.Decision: typed authority target only where the exact Decision operation is declared by the operation contract; Decision is append-only and its creation is owned/bound by its Subject
typed_target_map.FollowupEdge_and_other_canonical_objects: typed authority targets only when explicitly declared by the operation contract
typed_target_map.Execution.subject_ref: context/relationship reference only; it does not silently become an authority target

C_EXECUTION_TO_AUTHORITY_TARGET.source: A1 canonical_records (Subject/Execution/Decision/FollowupEdge ownership and relationship semantics) + A2 authority_evaluation_model (never chooses subjects, never invents scope) + lease object_ref exact target

D_REVISION_HANDOFF.expected_revision_semantics: expected_revision refers to the canonical revision of the exact typed authority target defined by M3-A3; this lane defines no revision numbering, hash, or CAS mechanics.
D_REVISION_HANDOFF.source: A2 capability_lease_contract (LEASE_REVISION_BOUND=yes, expected_revision field) + A2 implementation_boundary.future_lane_notes (M3-A3 owns CAS transaction implementation)

E_DECISION_BACKED_FOLLOWUP.semantic_followup_shape: A semantic followup is an A1 Decision-backed child Subject (FollowupEdge with source_decision_ref), never an engine-inferred intent.
E_DECISION_BACKED_FOLLOWUP.decision_role: A Decision is already-materialized semantic evidence/basis only. The authority engine mechanically verifies the exact Decision ownership/reference/operation/object/revision/scope as applicable; it never performs semantic reasoning, never creates a Decision, never chooses a parent, and never grants authority by itself. A valid lease plus the exact target revision remain required.
E_DECISION_BACKED_FOLLOWUP.source: A1 OQ-M3A1-04/OQ-M3A1-05 + D-M3A1-05/D-M3A1-06 (Decision owned by one Subject; followup = child Subject with source Decision) + A2 authority_evaluation_model (no semantic reasoning; semantic decision evidence checked and bound)

F_CHILD_SUBJECT_CREATION.child_creation_rule: The semantic decision that a followup should exist is LLM/user authority materialized as a Decision record. Mechanical child Subject creation is a future bounded transition authorized by a valid Decision plus a valid lease plus the exact target revision.
F_CHILD_SUBJECT_CREATION.source: A1 OQ-M3A1-05 (followup = child Subject, FOLLOWUP_REQUIRES_SOURCE_DECISION=yes) + A2 authority evaluation (semantic decision evidence bound; engine never creates Decisions)
